damageLaw: In the palace almost every hit takes bar hits off a man, not a KO: her harp shot (2 bar hits, MEGA 3), the guard's jab (1), the knight's jab (2), the slinger's glob (1), the wasp's sting (1, and the man is held 2 s), the hornet's sting (3), the frog's splat and tongue (1 each) and the sage's fire (1 a beat, ten beats); a bar hit lands 90 % + 10 % × bar ÷ HP of its weight, and a level-70–90 man has 7 bar hits (6 the medic and spy, 8 the commando). Three hits are a KO whatever a man's HP: the guard's ram, her light arrows (MEDIUM up) and her face shot (a Sarge within 84 px); only the arrows go through every save (the saber turns the ram about half the time, THE RIOT SHIELD's 5 and the Claymore's counted block eat the ram and the face shot). Difficulty changes her bar (×2 · ×2.4 · ×6 · ×9), her lives (1 · 1 · 3 · 3), her cadence and the court's size and HP; a hit's weight does not change except MEGA's third bar hit on her harp.
headlines: Almost every hit in the palace takes BAR HITS, not a KO: her harp 2 (MEGA 3), the guard's jab 1, the knight's jab 2, the slinger 1, the wasp 1 (held 2 s), the hornet 3 (bowled over), the frog 1 + 1, the sage's fire 1 a beat for 10 beats.
A level-70 man has 7 bar hits (the medic and spy 6, the commando 8), so her harp KOs him on the 4th shot on EASY to HARD and the 3rd on MEGA; a bar hit lands 90 % + 10 % × bar ÷ HP of its weight.

Three KOs whatever a man's HP: the gnome guard's RAM (a man ahead within 300 px; the V2 jeep and the tank destroyed on the spear; the saber turns it about half the time, THE RIOT SHIELD's 5 and the Claymore's counted block eat it), her LIGHT ARROWS (MEDIUM up at half her bar, MEGA again at a quarter: the one hit that goes through every save) and her FACE SHOT (a Sarge within 84 px, through the saber's block; the riot shield and the Claymore's block eat it, the deflect dome turns it).
A charged commando catches a light arrow and throws it back: she loses a quarter of her bar (96 · 240 · 360 HP on M · H · G) and every gnome in its path falls — but he catches only one a fight.

HARD and MEGA give her three bars (960 / 1,440 each); at a zero with bars left she flies back to her stage and calls THE BUBBLE COURT (3 + 3 / 4 + 4), whose big guards charge your line at ×2.2; MEGA fires the arrows at every retreat too.

The sage turns Sarge into a toad for 5 s (no fire, no swing) and lights three rings under your rearmost men (a man who stands in one is KO'd on the 8th beat); the knight's shield turns every round from the front, the guard's every 2nd.

units.name: THE GNOME GUARD
units.note: walks 26 px/s · his shield turns every 2nd round from the front, bullets do half and blasts double on his armour (measured) · a fairy's bubble makes him BIG: ×4 HP, ×1.5 size · Princess Croak's summoned guards charge the line at ×2.2 once big

attacks.name: RAM
attacks.cadence: braces 0.45 s then charges 380 px/s at a man ahead within 300 px, 100 px past him, rests 1.6 s
attacks.note: a KO whatever his HP unless a save answers: the ram reaches the KO door with no roll spent, so the saber turns it about half the time (measured 6/10 · 7/8 · 6/3 · 9/11 of 16 fresh saber Sarges KO'd on E · M · H · G, Chrome/WebKit), THE RIOT SHIELD's 5 and the Claymore's counted block (1: THE DUELIST, every Claymore's default spec; three only with FEAR or WALL picked) eat it whole (measured: the shotgun Sarge fell to the 6th ram, the Claymore to the 2nd), the pet shield, the blue wall and the teal turn it; the deflect dome does not (its KO door catches only the officer's potshot and her face shot); a rifleman, a flame and a pistol Sarge 200 px ahead KO'd at 0.92 s on every tier (measured); a jeep or the tank on the spear is destroyed (the V2 jeep and the tank measured); the scout jeep's own clip runs a mortal guard down first (measured)
attacks.code: updateFoeTrike (the ram bag) → knock (unrolled: sargeAbsorbs, cmdAbsorbs, saberBlocks answer); the vehicle branch → knockKill

questions.text: A balance read, not a bug: nothing in the palace scales a hit with the level of your men except her harp's third bar hit on MEGA. At level 70–90 every man has 7 bar hits (6 the medic and spy, 8 the commando), so her harp KOs any man on the 4th shot (3rd on MEGA) and a guard's jab on the 8th, the same for a rifleman and a flame.
questions.rec: Raziya's call: if the heavies should last longer in the palace, a tier cell on her harp or the court's jabs (a per-tier hit multiplier like the hideout's) would do it.

questions.text: The commando catches ONE light arrow a fight (the catch is marked once and never cleared); on MEGA the second volley KO'd the commando who had just caught the first.
questions.rec: A design question for Wyatt: is one catch a fight the intent, or should the charge return?

questions.text: The face shot goes through the saber's block (the shot is sent with the saber's roll switched off: the KO door's rolled flag, by design), while the riot shield (shotgun, 5 a battle), the Claymore's counted block (1: THE DUELIST, every Claymore's default spec) and the deflect dome answer it: the plate and the block eat it whole (measured: he falls to the 6th / 2nd face shot). The guard's ram reaches the same door with NO roll spent, so every save answers it: the saber turns about half the rams (measured 6/10 · 7/8 · 6/3 · 9/11 of 16 KO'd), the plate and the block eat them too.
questions.rec: As designed ("built-in auto-kill for any Sarge that comes too close"); noted so the page reads right: only her light arrows go through every save.

questions.text: A gnome guard destroys the tank on the spear (0.9 s from 200 px), the same law as the V2 jeep; the scout jeep's clip kills a mortal guard first, the tank's gun does too (0.3 s) — but an unkillable guard proved the spear lands on the tank.
questions.rec: Raziya's call whether the tank should be a spear kill.

questions.text: The slinger's measured cadence wanders 3.0–3.6 s against a 3.0 s clock + a 0.6 s aim; the game's own clock, not a bug.

notes: WHO SURVIVES counts hits of that strike in a row (inside the 4 s mend) that KO a fresh man at the lab's level (EASY 70 · MEDIUM 77 · HARD 83 · MEGA 90); the sage's fire rings count beats (10 in a ring's 5 s life). A dot in a cell's corner marks a man whose count the proof confirmed on both engines (Chrome for Testing + WebKit); the other cells are the read's arithmetic. A + in a cell's corner = a save ate some hits first (the riot shield's 5, the Claymore's counted block, the saber's turn): the number is every hit that reaches him, the save's share included; the words sit in the cell's tooltip.

The saber Sarge's harp count is arithmetic (7 · 7 · 7 · 5 on E · M · H · G): his block turns about half the shots and the gaps let his bar mend 1 every 4 s, so the machines measured 9/11 · 12/9 · 7/7 · 5/7 landed shots to his KO (Chrome/WebKit).

The KO hits and the saves: her light arrows go through every save. Her face shot is sent with the saber's roll switched off (the KO door's rolled flag, by design: the auto-kill for a Sarge who comes too close), so THE RIOT SHIELD (5 a battle, the shotgun) and the Claymore's counted block (1 a battle: THE DUELIST, every Claymore's default spec; the table's 3 only with FEAR or WALL picked) eat it, and the deflect dome turns it (its KO door catches her face shot): survive 6 / 2 (measured). The guard's ram meets every save: the saber turns it about half the time (measured 6/10 · 7/8 · 6/3 · 9/11 of 16 fresh Sarges KO'd per tier, Chrome/WebKit; survive 1 = a KO when it lands), the plate and the counted block eat it (survive 6 / 2, measured), the pet shield, the blue wall and the teal turn it; the deflect dome does not (its KO door catches only the officer's potshot and her face shot). THE LEVEL A MAN FIRST SURVIVES ONE HIT is by HP alone: no rank survives a KO hit; the plate and the block are gear.

The body HP × and head-count × columns are the fight's own dials (1 on every tier in the palace); her bar rides her own multiplier (×2 · ×2.4 · ×6 · ×9) and the court's bodies the court's (×1 · ×1.25 · ×1.5 · ×1.8).

The two engines' reads are identical and every damage fact in the two proofs agrees; what differs is dice and clocks: the saber Sarge's harp shots landed to his KO (9/11 · 12/9 · 7/7 · 5/7 on E · M · H · G); the gnome's ram on 16 fresh saber Sarges (6/10 · 7/8 · 6/3 · 9/11 KO'd); EMPEROR BEAR's shots landed in 60 s (EASY 20/22, MEDIUM 23/25, MEGA 21/16); PRINCESS CROAK's shots landed in 60 s (EASY 20/21, MEDIUM 25/24); the frame a hit lands on, and the slinger's wander.
